FLOE T- 223A
GAS TURBINE ENGINE PERFORMANCE CALCULATOR
INSTRUCTIONS
The information obtained from this calculator is for normal cruise, i.e. straight and
level flight, air-condition and pressurization bleed from pod engines, no bleed from
center engine andyengines stabilized for five minutes.
Determine indicated values from
aircraft instruments:
1. TRUE RAM AIR TEMP. (RAT)
2. ENGINE PRESSURE RATIO (EPR)
3. TRUE MACH NO.
4. PRESSURE ALTITUDE (Flight Level)
II
1. Set TOTAL AIR TEMP index on TRUE RAM AIR TEMP
2. Opposite N1 EPR POD ENG read Pod Engine NI
3.
Opposite N1 EPR CENTER ENG read Center Engine N1
4.
Opposite N2 EPR POD ENG read Pod Engine
1N2
5. Opposite N2 EPR CENTER ENG read Center Engine N2
6. Opposite EGT EPR POD ENG read Pod Engine EGT
• 7. Opposite EGT EPR CENTER ENG read Center Eng EGT
III (POD ENGINE FUEL FLOW)
1. Hold
TEMP INDEX ON RAT and set FLIGHT LEVEL (blue disc) on FUEL FLOW EPR (black lines)
2. Swing cursor to intersect TAT (or RAT) of cursor with MACH (outer scale on blue disc).
3. Under top portion of centerline read FUEL FLOW for Pod Engine in LBS/HR.
IV (CENTER ENGINE FUEL FLOW)
1. Perform same procedures as step III except set FLIGHT LEVEL on green line FUEL FLOW EPR.
TO CONVERT LBS/HR TO KGS/HR
1. Hold cursor on the fuel flow reading obtained
2. Rotate the blue disc so as to place the LBS line of the blue disc under the
centerline of cursor.
3.
Read fuel flow under the KGS line of blue disc one scale betow original Lbs/Hr
fuel flow reading.
1. RAT
2. EPR
3.
MACH NO.
4. ALT, FLT LVL
- 30°C
1.85
• 84
350
EXAMPLE
1. N1
2. N2
3. EGT
4. FUEL FLOW
Pod Eng 83.4% Cntr Eng 83. 6%
Pod
Eng 85.5% Cntr Eng 84.7%
Pod Eng 374°C Cntr Eng 366°C
Pod Eng 2500 LBS/HR or 1134 KGS/HR
Cntr Eng 2450 LBS/HR or 1111 KGS/HR
NOTE:
This calculator is a generalization of engine performance and is intended for use as
a baseline for engine monitoring. Engine fuel consumption for use in calculating
airplane range characteristics must be obtained from
engine specification curves.
